style: Create a NEW image in exactly the same art style as the reference images: soft painterly semi-realistic digital illustration, lifelike natural people with realistic faces and expressions, cinematic lighting, deep purple / magenta background with teal-cyan glow accents, slight film grain. Vertical 9:16 full-frame composition that fills the whole frame, main subject in the center-left area, no empty borders. Absolutely no text, letters, captions, logos or watermarks unless the scene explicitly asks for clock digits. The main character is always the same young blonde athletic woman (long blonde hair in a ponytail, early twenties, fit and sporty, natural beauty) as in the character reference image.
